item.title: After being declared deceased, living man receives Social Security benefits
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Last week, Herman Banks was a walking, talking dead man. The bass fisherman says his life changed in a matter of weeks, unbeknownst to him.&nbsp;It wasn't until Banks went to withdraw cash from his checking account did he learn something was wrong. His account didn't have its typical balance. item.title: Iberville officials asking for information about boat, firearm thefts
item.description: GROSSE TETE - Officials in Iberville Parish are asking the public for information about multiple thefts in Grosse Tete and Rosedale.&nbsp;The Iberville Parish Sheriff's Office said two boats containing guns and a generator were stolen recently. item.title: LSU AgCenter trying to preserve genetic material of Louisiana crawfish through cryogenic preservation
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Scientists at LSU's AgCenter are using cryogenic freezing to preserve the genetic material of Louisiana crawfish, among other aquatic species.At the Aquatic Germplasm and Genetic Resources Center, researchers store sperm, eggs, and embryos of aquatic species in liquid nitrogen.
